newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ to hold branch managers' meeting July 14-15.
newsitem.headline: BOJ to hold branch managers' meeting July 14-15.

text.p: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) said on Thursday it will hold a regular meeting of its branch managers on July 14 and 15 at its Tokyo headquarters.
The quarterly meeting is closely watched by financial markets for clues to changes in the central bank's assessment of the economy.
The branch managers are expected to discuss economic conditions in their respective regions.
